provenance_rules.title_provenance: Must match exact published document title or official government notification.
provenance_rules.coordinate_provenance: Must derive from SCAR Composite Gazetteer of Antarctica or Norwegian Polar Institute Place Names Database.
provenance_rules.measurement_provenance: Must trace back to calibrated sensor raw datalogger or published scientific paper.
provenance_rules.licensing_provenance: Must contain verifiable link to published copyright / Creative Commons attribution.
